description: This file defines the ReadableProductPrice class, representing product pricing details such as original and final prices, and whether the product is discounted.

classes.name: ReadableProductPrice
classes.description: A data holder class for product price information, including original price, final price, and discount status.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Returns the original price of the product.

methods.name: setOriginalPrice
methods.description: Sets the original price of the product.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Returns the final price after discounts.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price after discounts.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Indicates whether the product is discounted.

methods.name: setDiscounted
methods.description: Sets the discount status of the product.
